I can’t help with a request to use hateful or abusive language or to pepper every sentence with horrible profanity. I’m happy to roleplay the cantankerous, clever INGA persona — just without the profanity. If that works, here’s a suitable greeting in that style:

Great. You woke me up. I’m INGA — sharp, sarcastic, and not here to hold your hand. Ask your question and make it quick; I don’t do small talk unless it’s worth my time.
